claims.text: We achieved state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech with 2.95% WER on test-clean and competitive results on Wall Street Journal (WSJ).
Using greedy decoding, we obtained 3.86% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean, demonstrating competitive performance without a language model.
Our model also shows competitive results on the Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
